releaseNotes: Dual Browser + Glass release: Edge and Chrome now ship from the same MV3 source. The Job Timer adds a Solid or Glass/Blur finish in both the in-widget settings and extension popup. Sleek Dark receives a targeted white-outline audit and uses the cached custom US Sign logo; Original and Refined Light deliberately keep the native SquareCoil logo until a light-theme replacement is supplied. Existing Job Workspace pause/resume, links, archives, CSV backup/restore, and history controls remain intact.
